title: True Dweomers
audit_comment: CHAPTER 6 of the DMO (printed pp. 118-141), the 10th-level spell system closing in one round: the requirement gates (the 20th level, the ability 18, the four-per-day cap, the unrecordable rule), the difficulty calculus (the level and specialist and practiced adjustments, the component and condition reductions, the save and resistance trades), the eight grids (the Table 28 type ladder with its duel-type mirror, the Table 29 areas, the Table 30 animated objects, the Table 31 ranges, the Table 32 durations, the Table 33 prep-and-cast bands), the school effects from dispel and ward through slay and tap with their doubling and tripling ladders, the preparation and final-check rules, the Pharjis worked creation at 110 through 10, the in-play and dueling and quest-spell doctrines with the duel PR 19, and the thirteen known dweomers with their difficulty pairs.
audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----

banner.title: TRUE DWEOMERS - DMO Chapter 6 closes: the requirement gates (wizards and priests of 20th level with ability 18, at most four dweomers a day, never scrollable or storable), the difficulty calculus (the combined type-plus-area-plus-range-plus-duration total less the caster level, less five for a specialist, less ten when practiced, then the component and condition reductions - three rares at minus ten each within a 30-point limit, an exotic at half or minus 20), the eight grids (the Table 28 29-type ladder from charm 20 through slay 50 with the variable shadow shape, the Table 29 areas from five feet to a whole plane at difficulty 160, the Table 30 animated objects, the Table 31 ranges touch through trans-planar, the Table 32 durations instantaneous through permanent at 100, the Table 33 prep-and-cast bands - a year of preparation and a week of casting at 151-plus - and the Table 35 duel-type mirror), the school effects (the dispel 50-percent read at 11-plus on 1d20, the ward ladder to the 210-point full resistance, the reflect, fortify, transform, afflict, conjure, summon, imbue, reveal and tap ladders in their doubling and tripling steps, the strike capped at 30d8), the preparation doctrine (the eight-hour day, the restart and backtrack rules, the 1d100 final check, the halve-or-minus-10 extension trade), the Pharjis worked creation computing 110 down to a final 10 with the 02-fail and 81-success rolls, the in-play doctrine (the duel PR 19, the wish auto-dispel, the quest-spell ward floor of 18), and the thirteen known dweomers from Hurd's Obligation to Yunni's Herald with their difficulty pairs.
banner.provenance: verified against printed pp. 118-141 of the uploaded DMO session capture (part 2, printed page N at OCR page N+90); the requirements and calculus from pp. 118-120, the Table 28 grid and school effects from pp. 120-130, the Tables 29 through 33 from pp. 130-133, the preparation and final-check rules from pp. 133-134, the worked creation from p. 134, the in-play and duel and quest doctrines from pp. 134-136, the thirteen known dweomers from pp. 136-141. The worked-example region watch reads a half-day duration at +10; Table 32 prints six hours at 7 and 12 hours at 10 - the example's own arithmetic (+10) is pinned verbatim with the note here.
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 79 closed, 17 open - Chapter 6 is DONE in one round, ten boxes flip (nine children and the parent); the DMO arc continues with Chapter 7 (High-Level Characters, pp. 142-164).

consts.name: devNejaPleaHours
consts.comment: Neja's Irresistible Plea: compels a task of 12 hours or less, saving throw negates at -3 (printed p. 138).

consts.name: devNejaPleaSaveBonus
consts.comment: Neja's Irresistible Plea: the -3 saving throw modifier (printed p. 138).

consts.name: devRatecliffeHd
consts.comment: Ratecliffe's Deadly Finger: slays 40 Hit Dice of creatures in a 50-foot square; those under 9 Hit Dice get no save (printed p. 140).

consts.name: devRatecliffeAreaFt
consts.comment: Ratecliffe's Deadly Finger: the 50-foot square (printed p. 140).

consts.name: devTenserDmgDice
consts.comment: Tenser's Telling Blow: a force blast of 20d8 + 20 points of damage, save for half; only against creatures already engaged in combat (printed p. 140).

consts.name: devTenserDmgBonus
consts.comment: Tenser's Telling Blow: the +20 bonus damage (printed p. 140).

consts.name: devWulfRectAreaDia
consts.comment: Wulf's Rectification: banishes 1d4+1 extra-planar usurpers in a 50-foot diameter, magic resistance at -20 percent (printed p. 141).

consts.name: devWulfRectMrPenalty
consts.comment: Wulf's Rectification: the -20 percent magic resistance penalty (printed p. 141).

consts.name: devYunniWeightLbs
consts.comment: Yunni's Herald: animates objects of 50 pounds or less, moving at speed 12 to deliver a spoken message for up to a week (printed p. 141).

consts.name: devT28RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 28 grid: 29 spell types across the eight schools, abjuration through necromancy (printed p. 120).

consts.name: devT29RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 29 grid: ten area-of-effect rows from a single creature to a whole plane (printed p. 130).

consts.name: devT30RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 30 grid: six animated-object size rows, tiny through gargantuan (printed p. 130).

consts.name: devT31RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 31 grid: ten range rows, touch through trans-planar (printed p. 131).

consts.name: devT32RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 32 grid: eleven duration rows, instantaneous through permanent (printed p. 131).

consts.name: devT33RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 33 grid: ten adjusted-difficulty bands from -1-or-less through 151-plus (printed p. 132).

consts.name: devT35RowCount
consts.comment: the Table 35 grid: the 29 dweomer types mapped to their dueling types (printed p. 135).

consts.name: devProvinceMiles
consts.comment: the area codes: a province is 20 miles square, a region 100 miles square, a plane fills the plane (printed p. 130).

consts.name: devRegionMiles
consts.comment: the area codes: the region dimension (printed p. 130).

consts.name: devAreaAllCreaturesMult
consts.comment: the area read: affecting all creatures in a designated area multiplies the difficulty modifier by 10 (printed p. 130).

bools.name: devNoScrollOrDevice
bools.comment: the unrecordable rule: a true dweomer can never be written onto a scroll, recorded in a spellbook or stored in a magical device (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devNeverSameTwice
bools.comment: the flux rule: every true dweomer is a little different each time it is cast - the energies constantly change (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devDmApprovalRequired
bools.comment: the approval gate: the DM must approve a true dweomer before it is used; there is no cost beyond materials (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devWizardsAnySchool
bools.comment: the school rule: wizards cast dweomers using their available schools; priests use any school but must reflect their deity's portfolio (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devCommonComponentRequired
bools.comment: the component floor: every true dweomer requires at least one common material component, with no difficulty reduction for multiples (printed p. 131).

bools.name: devPriestHolySymbolNeeded
bools.comment: the priest read: priest dweomers require holy symbols, not consumed; other components are (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devWizardsNeedNoSpellbook
bools.comment: the wizard read: no spellbook needed, though written notes help (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devComponentsSymbolic
bools.comment: the symbolism rule: a component must be symbolic of what the spell does - a diamond for earth or value, not mere cost (printed p. 119).

bools.name: devExoticEitherNotBoth
bools.comment: the exotic component: a single exotic component reduces either the adjusted or the final difficulty, never both (printed p. 131).

bools.name: devWardHalfEvenOnFail
bools.comment: the ward read: even if the save fails, damage from the warded attack is reduced by half (printed p. 122).

bools.name: devWardTwoResistRolls
bools.comment: the ward read: a warded creature with magic resistance gets two separate resistance rolls, never added (printed p. 122).

bools.name: devTransformSimplePermanentFree
bools.comment: the transform read: a simple transformation of nonmagical material can be made permanent without a Constitution loss (printed p. 124).

bools.name: devAfflictHarmlessPermanentFree
bools.comment: the afflict read: a harmless affliction can be made permanent without a Constitution loss, as can a condition the victim can end (printed p. 124).

bools.name: devBindYearlySave
bools.comment: the bind read: a binding of a year or more allows a yearly saving throw to break it (printed p. 125).

bools.name: devBindNoSuicide
bools.comment: the bind read: no binding is effective if impossible to honor or suicidal (printed p. 125).

bools.name: devSummonNoControlOvernamed
bools.comment: the summon read: a creature over the caster's level, or specifically named, is beyond control though it can be bound, charmed or compelled (printed p. 125).

bools.name: devGolemsNeverCharmed
bools.comment: the charm read: golems, automatons and animated objects cannot be charmed (printed p. 125).

bools.name: devRevealNoSaveUnlessUnwilling
bools.comment: the reveal read: no saving throw unless examining an unwilling creature's alignment, thoughts or mental state (printed p. 127).

bools.name: devConcealBrokenByAttack
bools.comment: the conceal read: an attack breaks the concealment unless combined with an imbue of the same duration (printed p. 127).

bools.name: devTrueSeeingDefeatsConceal
bools.comment: the conceal read: true seeing always defeats a conceal spell (printed p. 127).

bools.name: devPhantomNoRealDamage
bools.comment: the phantom read: an image cannot inflict real damage even if believed - but a mental fear image can kill like a slay spell (printed p. 127).

bools.name: devMatterPermanentFree
bools.comment: the create read: matter-producing creation can be made permanent without a Constitution loss (printed p. 129).

bools.name: devForceImmuneToOwnEnergy
bools.comment: the strike read: the mobile effect is harmed only by magic and is immune to its own form of energy (printed p. 129).

bools.name: devOnlyPriestsHealWithTap
bools.comment: the tap read: priests, and only priests, use the tap spell to heal injuries (printed p. 129).

bools.name: devTapDamageInstantOnly
bools.comment: the tap read: a damage-inflicting tap is always instantaneous and cannot be extended (printed p. 129).

bools.name: devPrepDayRestart
bools.comment: the disruption rule: preparations of a day or less are completely disrupted and restart (printed p. 133).

bools.name: devPrepWeekBacktrack
bools.comment: the disruption rule: week-or-longer preparations lose the current day plus another day of backtracking (printed p. 133).

bools.name: devPrepExtensionHalves
bools.comment: the time trade: raising preparation one category halves the final difficulty or takes -10, whichever is greater; shortening doubles it (printed p. 133).

bools.name: devCastDailyNoBreaks
bools.comment: the casting read: day-or-longer casting needs eight hours daily, consecutive; a missed day loses the spell (printed p. 134).

bools.name: devCastBrokenRuinsSpell
bools.comment: the casting read: broken concentration during casting ruins the spell and consumes the components in a fizzle (printed p. 133).

bools.name: devPlayCasterLevelSaves
bools.comment: the in-play read: the saving-throws-by-character-level optional rule is always used, and high-ability bonuses apply normally (printed p. 134).

bools.name: devIounStonesIneffective
bools.comment: the in-play read: pale lavender and lavender-and-green ioun stones, rods of absorption and staffs of the magi absorption are ineffective against true dweomers (printed p. 134).

bools.name: devDispelMagicAreaCapped
bools.comment: the in-play read: dispel magic cannot disrupt a dweomer whose area exceeds its own (printed p. 134).

bools.name: devWishAutoDispels
bools.comment: the in-play read: a wish automatically dispels a true dweomer, its only effect; a limited wish negates for 1d8 hours (printed p. 135).

bools.name: devDispelDestroysBarriers
bools.comment: the barrier read: a dispel true dweomer instantly destroys any wall or barrier from a 1st-9th level spell or device - wall of force, prismatic wall and sphere, antimagic shell, cube of force (printed p. 135).

bools.name: devSphericalBarriersHold
bools.comment: the barrier read: flat barriers are circumvented by a big enough area, spherical ones cannot be (printed p. 135).

bools.name: devDuelCountersUseless
bools.comment: the duel read: any dweomer with a casting time over one round is useless as a counter spell (printed p. 135).

bools.name: devQuestSpellsUncounterable
bools.comment: the quest read: quest-spell effects generally cannot be countered; a dispel dweomer is ineffective, though creatures and wardable effects can be attacked (printed p. 135).

bools.name: devQuestWardMrHalved
bools.comment: the quest read: the halved magic resistance (printed p. 136).

bools.name: devNazzerAutoFailOne
bools.comment: Nazzer's Nullification: a roll of 1 always fails and a 20 always succeeds (printed p. 138).

bools.name: devNejaToadstoolSystemShock
bools.comment: Neja's Toadstool: Nazzer's nullification can reverse the transform, but a system shock roll is required with failure meaning death (printed p. 138).

bools.name: devRatecliffeWishOnlyRevival
bools.comment: Ratecliffe's Deadly Finger: the slain revive only by a wish, another true dweomer or a deity (printed p. 140).

tables.name: devT28Grid
tables.comment: the Table 28 true dweomers grid (printed p. 120): 29 spell types by school with the base difficulty, the base duration code (0 instantaneous, 1 one round, 2 round or instantaneous, -99 variable) and the effect code (0 area, 1 creature or object, 2 object, 3 creature or area, 4 creature, -99 variable); the shadow shape row is variable in all three.
col_comments: the base difficulty by type: banish 30, dispel 30, reflect 25, ward 35; the alteration ladder 25 through 45; the conjuration 35 through 50; enchantment 20 through 45; divination 20 and 25; illusion 20 through 40; evocation 25 through 45; necromancy 25 through 50; the shadow shape is variable (printed p. 120).
the base duration code: 0 instantaneous, 1 one round, 2 round or instantaneous by use, -99 the variable shadow shape (printed p. 120).
the effect code: 0 area, 1 creature or object, 2 object, 3 creature or area, 4 creature, -99 variable (printed p. 120).

tables.name: devT29Grid
tables.comment: the Table 29 areas of effect (printed p. 130): ten rows - the creature count (the parenthetical fixed numbers), the area in square feet (-99 the province, region and plane rows), the object weight cap in pounds, and the difficulty modifier from 0 through 160.
col_comments: the creature count: 1, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27 - the fixed parenthetical numbers of the dice entries (printed p. 130).
the area in feet: 5, 50, 500, 5,000, 10,000, 25,000, 50,000, then province, region and plane - a province 20 miles square, a region 100 (printed p. 130).
the object weight cap in pounds: 200 through one million, a 500-ton plane row (printed p. 130).

tables.name: devT30Grid
tables.comment: the Table 30 animated objects (printed p. 130): six size rows, tiny through gargantuan, with the weight cap in pounds and the average damage of a single blow; objects over a ton cannot wholly move.
col_comments: the weight cap in pounds: 50, 100, 200, 500, 1,000 and a one-ton gargantuan row (printed p. 130).
the average damage per blow: 2, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 (printed p. 130).

tables.name: devT31Grid
tables.comment: the Table 31 ranges (printed p. 131): ten rows, touch through trans-planar; only transport and reveal spells work at trans-planar range, and planar range serves unknown locations.
col_comments: the range difficulty: touch 0, 20 yards 5, 50 yards 10, 100 yards 15, 500 yards 20, 1,000 yards 25, 1,500 yards 30, line of sight 40, plane 60, trans-planar 100 (printed p. 131).

tables.name: devT32Grid
tables.comment: the Table 32 durations (printed p. 131): eleven rows, instantaneous through permanent; a permanent spell usually drains a point of Constitution; instantaneous effects are lasting.
col_comments: the duration difficulty: instantaneous 0, one round 1, one turn 3, one hour 5, six hours 7, 12 hours 10, one day 15, one week 30, one month 50, one year 70, permanent 100 (printed p. 131).

tables.name: devT33Grid
tables.comment: the Table 33 preparation and casting times (printed p. 132): ten adjusted-difficulty bands from -1-or-less through 151-plus; the preparation code (0 none, 1 round, 2 turn, 3 day, 4 week, 5 two weeks, 6 month, 7 two months, 8 six months, 9 year) beside the casting code (0 round, 1 turn, 2 hour, 3 day, 4 week).
col_comments: the preparation time code: none at -1 or less, round at 0, turn through 5, day 6-10, week 11-20, two weeks 21-30, month 31-50, two months 51-100, six months 101-150, year at 151-plus (printed p. 132).
the casting time code: round through 10, turn 11-20, hour 21-50, day 51-150, week at 151-plus (printed p. 132).

tables.name: devT35Grid
tables.comment: the Table 35 true dweomer spell types for duels (printed p. 135): the 29 dweomer types aligned with the Table 28 rows, mapped to dueling types - attack 0, defense 1, attack/defense 2, leech 3, missile 4, any 5, attack/defense-or-missile 6.
col_comments: the dueling type code: banish attack, dispel attack/defense, reflect and ward defense; alteration animate attack/defense, destroy fortify transport leeches, transform attack; conjures attack or leech, summon attack/defense; the enchantments attack or leech; divinations leech; conceal delude leech, phantom any, shadow shape attack/defense-or-missile; create attack/defense, strike missile; necromancy animate attack/defense, tap and slay attack (printed p. 135).

tables.name: devKnownDweomers
tables.comment: the known true dweomers grid (printed pp. 136-141): thirteen documented dweomers with the difficulty rating before reductions and the final difficulty as cast by a nonspecialist 20th-level caster with all listed components plus the -10 practiced adjustment - Hurd's Obligation, Kolin's Undead Legion, Kreb's Flaming Dragon, Kreb's Stately Veil, Nazzer's Nullification, Neja's Irresistible Plea, Neja's Toadstool, Neja's Unfailing Contempt, Ratecliffe's Deadly Finger, Tenser's Telling Blow, Wulf's Erasure, Wulf's Rectification, Yunni's Herald.
col_comments: the final difficulty: 45, 45, 5, 5, -5, 0, 3, 3, 0, -7, 8, 2, -2 - Nazzer's base version; the cloak runs 13 (printed pp. 136-141).

the Pharjis 160 read: halved by the two-year preparation is 80 (printed p. 134)
the Table 28 read: slay is the hardest base at 50, charm and conceal and reveal the easiest at 20 (printed p. 120)

the Table 28 shadow shape row: variable throughout (printed p. 120)
the Table 29 read: the plane row costs 160 with a million-pound object cap (printed p. 130)
the Table 29 read: the base row is one creature, five feet, zero difficulty (printed p. 130)

the Table 31 read: touch is free, trans-planar costs 100 (printed p. 131)
the Table 32 read: one round costs 1, one year 70, permanent 100 (printed p. 131)

table_checks.note: the Table 33 read: the top band prepares a year and casts a week (printed p. 132)

table_checks.note: the known list: Kolin's Legion is the hardest at 325; Neja's Plea the easiest at 60 (printed pp. 136-139)
the known list: Tenser's final runs negative at -7, Yunni's at -2 (printed pp. 140-141)
the ward resistance ladder: 105 for 50 percent, 210 for 100 (printed p. 122)
the reflect ladder: 25 doubled 50 tripled 75 (printed p. 122)
the fortify ladder: 30, 60, 90, 120 in even multiples (printed p. 124)

table_checks.note: the dispel read: 11-or-higher on d20 is the 50-percent base (printed p. 122)
the strike read: 2d8 base, +1d8 per five, capped at 30d8 (printed p. 129)
the animate dead ladder: 25, 50, 75 (printed p. 129)
the tap transfer ladder: 80, 160, 120, 240 (printed p. 130)
the area multiplier: all-creatures spells cost ten times the modifier (printed p. 130)
the duration past read: Table 32 divided by ten makes ten years cost 70 (printed p. 127)
the requisites: 20th level, ability 18, four per day (printed p. 119)
